title: Paystride Save Saving-Streak Bonus Terms and Take-Back Conditions
content:
## 1. The bonus

1.1 A Paystride Save streak bonus of the tier's bonus amount is credited when the worker's streak count reaches the tier's number of pay periods that complete a streak, at most the tier's number of bonuses in any 365 days; tiers with a zero bonus pay none.

1.2 The streak count is taken over the worker's card pay periods, counting back from the most recent: it is the number of consecutive pay periods, since the last bonus, whose total deposits into savings reach the tier's per-period deposit figure. A pay period whose deposits total less than that figure ends the run.

1.3 The number of bonuses is counted over the 365 calendar days ending today: the bonuses credited in that window are counted against the tier's allowance.

## 2. Taking a bonus back

2.1 A bonus is taken back only within the tier's take-back period of calendar days after it was credited. Calendar days are counted from the day after the bonus entry date, so the last day a clawback can apply is that date plus the days.

2.2 When the balance falls below the tier's balance floor within that time because of a withdrawal, the bonus is taken back in full, the take-back pointing to that bonus, or the balance is taken back when it is smaller than the bonus. Interest credits never trigger a clawback.

### The take-back window, worked through

The window opens the day after the bonus is booked and closes at the end of the bonus entry date plus the take-back period in calendar days; that last day is inside the window. With a hypothetical bonus booked on 10 March and a take-back period of 30 calendar days:

| Day of the withdrawal that takes the balance below the floor | Inside the window | Take-back |
|---|---|---|
| 11 March (day 1) | Yes | applies |
| 9 April (day 30, the last day) | Yes | applies |
| 10 April (day 31) | No | none |

### The amount taken back (hypothetical figures)

On a hypothetical bonus of $10.00 and a balance floor of $25.00:

- a withdrawal inside the window leaves a balance of $18.00, below the floor: the $10.00 bonus is taken back in full;
- a withdrawal inside the window leaves a balance of $6.00, below the floor and smaller than the bonus: $6.00 is taken back;
- an interest credit is booked while the balance is below the floor: an interest credit never triggers a take-back.

### Points of judgement

- **Starter accounts.** A tier with a zero bonus pays none, so there is no bonus to take back.
- **Cause of the fall.** The take-back turns on a fall below the floor because of a withdrawal, inside the window.
- **Allowance reached.** Once the bonuses credited in the 365 calendar days ending today reach the tier's allowance, a completed streak does not add another bonus in that window.
